title: Simply More Discs
description: A simple and optimized modpack that adds more music Discs in game
body:
# More Music Discs 🎵

Immerse yourself in the rhythm of your Minecraft world with **More Music Discs**, a simple yet optimized modpack that expands the soundtrack of your adventures.  

Collect brand new discs, fill your jukebox with variety, and set the mood for every occasion — from quiet nights in your base to grand celebrations with friends.  

### ✨ Features
- A wide selection of new music discs to discover  
- Smooth and optimized gameplay with built-in performance mods  
- Lightweight and stable for both singleplayer and multiplayer worlds  
- Perfect balance between fun, simplicity, and atmosphere  

Turn your world into a living soundtrack and let every adventure play out with the perfect tune! 🎶
